seq.description: Position in the task's journal, one above the last ever written; never reused.

attempt.description: The attempt of the queue task (Queue Task Record, attempts[]).

kind.description: harness: text, tool_call, tool_result, file_changed, turn; server: the others.

text.description: text only: what the model wrote, masked and cut; untrusted.

truncated.description: text only: the text was cut to the bound.

target.description: A path, a command line, or a server link with its id; masked; untrusted.

path.description: file_changed only: a path relative to the worktree.

stop_reason.description: turn only: the turn's stop reason as the profile maps it (harness-profiles/01, What a Worker Does); null where the profile maps none. Recorded only; no rule reads it.

usage.description: turn only: the turn's usage figures read through the profile's pointers — the five token components and tool_uses as measured integers, unmeasured or not_applicable, and cost_usd as the number the harness reports or unmeasured (store-schemas/05, Metrics Store).

target.description: The entity or role the link names, for example TASK-007 or a consulted role.

signal.description: signal only: the same entry as the queue task record's signals[].

end.description: attempt_end only: the attempt's end (Queue Task Record, attempts[].end).

unmapped_lines.description: attempt_end only: output lines of the attempt that matched no mapping.
